title: Battery
author: @lunokjod
description:
The battery of the last hours, in a chart.
One sample every ten minutes, taken by an alarm so it is written whether the page is in front or not: the percentage now, the volts and the cable, the line of what the cell did, the hours of the window and how fast it is going up or down. Three windows —one hour, six and a day— and nothing predicted.
